scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
other_conditions: Must be a PhD student (science/engineering) enrolled in an Indian research institution or university.
Must have completed at least one year of the PhD curriculum.
Must submit a detailed activity plan for the fellowship.
Must obtain an endorsement/consent letter from the host industry/organization.
Must obtain NOC from the head of the institution.
Must obtain a recommendation letter from the mentor at the parent organization.
Must commence the fellowship within 3 months of result announcement.
Must abide by the conduct, rules & regulations of the German host organization and country.
Must submit a fellowship completion report within 4 weeks after completion.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of €1500, plus up to €1000 for round‑trip airfare and up to €100 per month for health insurance.
documents_required: NOC from the Head of the institution
